LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.CommandAbandonOutpostDesc: Abandon this outpost for good. Everything in store and every airdrop pod is discarded and the outpost itself is removed from the world, but the people stationed here are not lost: they are banished exactly the way vanilla banishes a pawn, and become free pawns on the world map. Whatever they are wearing and carrying goes with them. This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.ConfirmAbandonOutpost:
The outpost currently holds:

{0}

The outpost itself, everything in store, and every airdrop pod will be permanently discarded, with nothing to recover.
The people here are not discarded: they are banished exactly the way vanilla banishes a pawn, and become free pawns on the world map. Whatever they are wearing and carrying goes with them.

This cannot be undone.
